value.rationale: Finite two-agent binary-information partitions model a natural epistemic granularity, and uniform event-convergence depth is an operationally meaningful model-checking resource. Both different evaluation orders are classified for every finite n and depth cutoff, with sharp extremal structures. Distinct four-world depth distributions show genuinely different epistemic resources; this is an infinite-family theorem rather than a routine small-table increment.
